name: Waddle
summary: A polar night sign-in where a penguin follows your typing, hides his eyes and belly-slides when you get in
about: Four linked screens for a family sharing app called Waddle: sign in, create account, reset password with a 6-digit code, and a signed-in welcome. Pebble the penguin stands on an ice floe under a slow aurora; his eyes follow the caret as you type, his flippers cover his eyes for the password and one flipper lifts when you show it. He shakes his head at a wrong password, sweats a snowflake when Caps Lock is on, and builds an igloo block by block as a new password gets stronger.
how: Type an email: Pebble's eyes and head follow the caret letter by letter, and he says hello once the address is complete
Move to the password: both flippers cover his eyes; press the eye button and one flipper lifts so he can peek
Turn on Caps Lock in a password field for the snowflake sweat, or try a wrong password to see him shake his head
Press Type it for me, or sign in with mira@waddle.app and icefloe8, to see the belly slide and the live family feed
On Create account a stronger password builds an igloo block by block; 7 of the 12 blocks are needed to join
Reset password sends a demo code (482913); each digit lights a pebble on the ice, then you choose a new password
Themes follow your system or ?theme=light|dark, and Reset demo data in the footer clears saved accounts
